title: Hardcoded signing key 0x42..0x42 ships in production path
description: new_with_ipfs() at server_stores.rs:69 hardcodes SigningKey::from_bytes(&[0x42u8; 32]). This is the production startup path — every operator deployment will sign articles with the identical private key. Signatures cannot distinguish operators, and the key is trivially known to anyone reading the source. Any article the server emits bears a forged-looking signature. → Operator signing is completely broken as a trust mechanism. Fix: load key from config file or generate randomly on first run and persist.
